8. Plaintiff-petitioner on 26-5-1985 presented an application for Local Investigation under provision of Order 26, rule 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure for holding Local Investigation by a survey knowing Advocate of the Court on the following points: 

 (a) To ascertain the boundary line of Cadastral Survey plot No. 110 of Mouza-Tajkunipara and eastern boundary line of Cadastral Survey of plot No. 935 of Kafrul Mouza. 

 (b) To show suit property on the eastern part of Cadastral Survey plot No. 110 as shown by letters ABC and D. 

 (i). To ascertain the western boundary line of Cadastral Survey Plot No.110 of Mouja-Tejkunipara on relayment of Cadastral Survey Map. 

 (ii). To determine the location of Cadastral Survey plot No. 935 of adjacent Kafrul Mouza and relayment of Cadastral survey Map and determining the eastern boundary of the said plot, 

 (iii). To ascertain the quantum of plaintiffs purchased land covered in sale deed No. 3016 dated 24-3-1964 after ascertainment of the location of Cadastral Survey Plot No. 110. 

 20. Learned Assistant Judge by order under challenge in Revision dated 23-10-2000 rejected the said application for Local investigation. In recording rejection learned Assistant Judge held that plaintiff sought decree of possession on declaration of title with respect to 0.03 acres of property equivalent to 1400 square foot out of 0.0932 acres of property of Cadastral Survey Plot No.110 and that property had been well specified in schedule to the plaint and the said 0.03 acres of property is the subject matter of the suit and the demarcation of boundary through survey would not play any role in reaching to any decision in the suit. Learned Assistant Judge also took the view that the suit is of 18 years old and the proceeding of the suit would be prolonged by allowing unnecessary application of plaintiff. 

 27. Admittedly, the suit is for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession over the suit property. The suit is not for demarcation from Cadastral Survey plot No. 110 of Mouza Tejkunipara from Cadastrul Survey plot No. 935 of Mouza Kafrul. Defendant-opposite party did not challenge the identity of the suit property '03 acres of Cadastral Survey Plot No. 110 of Mouja Tejkunipara is the suit property and that property is well described by boundary.
